svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: VRRP gateway failover and preemption

g.text: Baseline: gw1 is MASTER (priority 150); traffic to VIP 10.36.0.1 flows through gw1.
keepalived stops on gw1; VRRP advertisements cease and gw2's master-down timer runs.
gw2 becomes MASTER, takes both VIPs and announces them with gratuitous ARP.
Traffic recovers through gw2; client and server keep their unchanged VIP routes.
keepalived restarts on gw1: preemption returns both VIPs to priority 150.
